'''Goats''' are [[farm]] [[animals]] that produce [[Goat Milk|goat milk]]. They are unlocked at [[experience]] level 32. They are the fifth and most expensive type of farm animal unlocked in the game.

Gender: Male

==='''Buying'''===
[[File:Goat Yard.png|150px|left|A goat yard]]
Goats must be placed in [[Goat Yard|goat yards]] to be purchased. Yards cost 1,000 {{Infoicon|coin}} each. They are unlocked at levels 32, 37 and 50. Each yard can house four goats.

At level 32 goats cost 2,150 coins each; at level 37 5,400 coins; at level 50 8,650 coins.

Goats and goat yards can be bought from the [[shop]].{{Infoicon|shop|bigger|link=Shop}}

{{Clr}}
----
==='''Harvesting'''===
[[File:Milk Bucket.png|150px|left|Milk bucket]]
Goat milk can be collected from goats every 8 hours. Players can skip the wait by paying 10 [[diamond]]s per goat. Players must then give goats [[Goat Feed|goat feed]] to get another harvest.

Goat feed is made of:

|'''x1'''
|'''x2'''
|}
----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
*It takes 40 minutes to make 3 units of [[Goat Feed|goat feed]]. You can easily collect all your milk and replenish your feed stock by the time the goats are ready to be milked again.
* Goat milk can quite easily be found in the [[Daily Dirt]] but sells quickly. Selling it at maximum price is recommended.
* Feeding farm animals and harvesting goat milk are common tasks in [[Derby|derbies]].
----
==='''Easter egg'''===
Tapping the goat yard or making a rock explode causes the goats to faint for a few seconds, then get back up and act normally. [[wikipedia:Fainting_goat|Fainting Goats]] (or "Myotonic Goats") exist in real life. This rare breed falls over with stiff legs for about 10 seconds when startled or excited.

{{Clr}}

----
==='''Easter egg'''===
Tapping the sheep pasture or making a rock explode scares the sheep, making them run from the perceived danger. In other circumstances sheep look nervous and easily frightened. This somewhat mimics their behavior in real life: sheep are quick to flee and panic, and are sensitive to noise.
----
==='''Did you know?'''===
* Where you tap hungry sheep, they turn into their full appearance. This only happens when you don’t have enough food to feed them. It lasts about 3 seconds.
* The ghost costume sheep wear during Halloween is alike [http://disney.wikia.com/wiki/Jacob_Marley Jacob Marley's] in the Disney adaptation of Dickens's ''A Christmas Carol''.

==='''Buying'''===
[[File:Chicken Coop.png|150px|left|A chicken coop]]
Chickens must be placed in [[Chicken Coop|chicken coops]] to be purchased. Coops cost 5 {{Infoicon|coin|link=Coin}} each.

They are unlocked at levels 1, 12 and 23. Each coop can house six chickens.

At level 1, chickens cost 20 coins each; at level 12, 140 coins; at level 23, 270 coins.

{{Clr}}----
==='''Harvesting'''===
[[File:Chicken Basket.png|left|150px|Egg basket]]
Eggs can be collected from chickens every 20 minutes. Players can skip the wait by paying 2 [[diamond]]s per chicken. Players must then give chickens [[Chicken Feed|chicken feed]] to get another harvest.

Chicken feed is made of:
{| border="0" cellpadding="2" cellspacing="1" style="text-align: center; margin: .5em 0;"
|-
|[[File:Corn.png|75px|Corn|link=Corn]]
|[[File:Wheat.png|75px|Wheat|link=Wheat]]
|-
|'''x1'''
|'''x2'''
|}
[[File:Chicken.gif|center|500px]]

{{Clr}}----
==='''Strategy tips'''===
* Making chicken feed only takes 5 minutes for 3 units. If you have two feed mills you can easily collect all your eggs and replenish your feed stock by the time the chickens are full again.
* Instead of collecting the eggs from the chickens every time they're ready, you may decide to let the chickens sit on the eggs until they're needed. That will keep precious barn storage space free for other items.
* If you decide to let the chickens sit on the eggs until they're needed, you can sell the excess [[Chicken Feed|chicken feed]] instead. Chicken feed sells very quickly at the maximum price of 72 coins for every 10 feed.
* Eggs are easily found in the [[Daily Dirt]], so eggs may not sell very well unless they're sold at a lower price.
* Feeding farm animals and harvesting eggs are common tasks in [[Derby|derbies]].
----
==='''Easter egg'''===
*Tapping the chicken coop scares the chickens and makes them try to fly away from the perceived danger. This mimics their behavior in real life: chickens mostly fly briefly when frightened.
----
==='''Did you know?'''===
*Chickens have a great memory. They can distinguish between over 100 different faces of people or animals.
*In real life, the Hay Day chicken's breed is the Californian White chicken.
----

The '''beehive tree''' is a shelter for [[Honey Bee|honey bees]], or more exactly the '''beehives''' the bees live in. It is unlocked at [[experience]] level 39.

It can be grown to shelter more beehives and therefore more honey bees.
{{Clr}}
----
==='''Growing '''===
The growth cycle of the tree depends on how much nectar has been brought to the beehives by the bees:
* when bees have collected 4,000 drops of [[Nectar Bush|nectar]] the tree gets another beehive and can hold up three more bees.
* the same happens when bees have collected 40,000 drops.
* the same happens when bees have collected 400,000 drops. The tree stops growing then.

As the tree grows its overall appearance changes:

{{BigIcon|Beehive Tree Stage 1}}{{BigIcon|Beehive Tree Stage 2}}{{BigIcon|Beehive Tree Stage 3}}{{BigIcon|Beehive Tree Stage 4}}

In addition to beehive(s) the beehive tree also has a bee smoker tied around its trunk and a honey jar on the ground next to it. These also evolve with the tree.
----
==='''Buying'''===
The beehive tree can be purchased in the [[shop]] for 4,000 {{Infoicon|coin}}. {{Infoicon|shop|bigger|link=Shop}}

Beehives come with the tree and do not have to be bought. Each beehive can house three bees.

Players can only have one beehive tree.
----
==='''Harvesting'''===
The tree itself does not produce anything: bees produce [[honeycomb]] within the beehives hung in the tree. Honeycomb is produced instantaneously once a hundred drops of nectar has been brought to the beehive. This takes approximately 35 minutes if bushes are close to the tree.
----

Lambs must be placed in [[Lamb Pasture|lamb pastures]] to be purchased. Pastures cost 500 {{Infoicon|coin}} each. They are unlocked at levels 25 and 30. Each pasture can house five lambs.

=== '''Strategy tips''' ===

* It takes 10 minutes to make 3 units of [[Lamb Feed|lamb feed]]. You can easily collect all your lamb chop and replenish your feed stock by the time the sheep are ready to be sheared again.
* Lamb chop can pretty regularly be found in the [[Daily Dirt]].
